principle: Complete the major post-Qin dynastic backbone from Qin through the fall of Qing, then expand remaining CORE with balanced research tranches. This is a project scheduling backbone, not a claim of historical orthodoxy, legitimacy, or ruler quality.

P0_DYNASTIC_BACKBONE_FULL_CHAIN.rule: Work chronologically. Finish every currently locked-CORE missing ruler in the current backbone lane before advancing to the next lane. Short reigns remain included when they are CORE. REVIEW claimants do not block the lane.
P0_DYNASTIC_BACKBONE_FULL_CHAIN.endpoint: Qing standard succession through Puyi / 1912 fall of the dynasty

P1_HIGH_LEVERAGE_ANCHORS.rule: Only starts after P0 has no locked-CORE missing rulers. Build a balanced first research tranche from remaining post-Qin CORE with a deterministic cross-polity sequence and descriptive source review. Do not score, rank, tier, endorse, or judge persons; queue position is work scheduling only.

P2_REMAINING_POST_QIN_CORE.rule: After the first balanced P1 tranche, systematically complete remaining post-Qin parallel and transition polity CORE, including lanes such as Liao, Western Liao, Western Xia, Jin, Ten Kingdoms, Sixteen Kingdoms, Southern Ming, major rival regimes, and other locked CORE not already in P0/P1.

P3_EARLY_AND_PREQIN_CORE.rule: Bulk-complete Xia/Shang/Zhou and pre-Qin polity CORE after the later historical backbone and post-Qin comparison network are mature. Sparse evidence must reduce model claims rather than trigger generic padding.

Q_REVIEW_AFTER_SCOPE_IDENTITY.rule: REVIEW/EXTENDED/LEGENDARY never enter bulk distillation merely to improve coverage. Resolve scope/identity/evidence-layer decisions first.

notes: The backbone deliberately includes all three Three-Kingdoms lanes and both major Northern/Southern dynasty sequences, avoiding an orthodoxy ranking in fragmented periods.
Liao, Western Xia and Jin remain CORE but were scheduled after the Qin-to-Qing P0 backbone; scheduling does not express a judgment of their importance.
P0 lane membership comes from the primary persons array only. Parallel-review/usurper fields do not block full-chain completion unless later promoted into the primary locked-CORE lane.
P1 uses neutral, reproducible research sequencing rather than person scores or historical-worth rankings.
